raw_summary_en: The patient reports a sudden crushing pressure in the chest that began about two hours ago while sitting at rest, spreading to the left arm and jaw. The patient also describes an earlier brief fainting spell, shortness of breath and cold sweats, and rates the pain 9 out of 10.
